post.description: Phase A preflight + Phase B1 bare schema.

Targeted second-pass search for cells that came back NOT_FOUND in a run.

For each missing (entity, field_id) pair, re-searches with higher result
counts (8 vs 5) and a larger per-entity budget (16 calls vs 10).
Streams `deepen_entity_done` events as entities finish; the frontend
merges new cells into the existing results table without a full reload.

Generate a fresh Excel file from the caller's current results.

The frontend calls this after a deep-retry completes, when the original
server-side export no longer reflects the updated table. Takes the full
results (including any deepened cells) and returns xlsx bytes directly.
No DB record is created — the file is returned inline.
